correctness.rationale: For q>3, dual minimum distance 3 ensures the q²−1 generator columns are distinct projective points S⊂PG(3,q). Minimality iff the zero section S∩H spans its hyperplane. The published weight distribution gives section sizes 2q−2,q,q−1,q−2,0. First exceeds q+1 for q≥5. q−1 sections c(0,b) lie on a single projective line by trace-zero Fq-scalar parametrization. If q sections lay on a line L, the pencil sum |S|+q|S∩L|=2q²−1 exceeds (q+1)(2q−2)=2q²−2. If q−2 sections lay on L, deficit 2q−1 forces another pencil hyperplane with q−1 zero points; that section is known collinear, and shares ≥3 L-points, so must use L and contradict |S∩L|=q−2. Empty section nonminimal. q=3: both admissible exponent-coset possibilities cyclic-multiplier equivalent to canonical C_(2,-1); its published minimal weights are 4,5. Independent direct GF(p²) generator and zero-column projective-rank enumeration for p=3,5,7 and multiple exponents reproduced all predicted weights and projective counts; finite enumerations do not replace the pencil proof.
